verdict.rationale: uv records exact dependency versions in a cross-platform `uv.lock` that `uv add` updates. Upgrades are opt-in via `--upgrade-package`, which keeps the rest of the lockfile intact. Python versions are pinned per project with `uv python pin`, which CI tooling respects, and tool versions can be pinned (`uvx ruff@0.6.0`), with tool upgrades respecting install-time constraints. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of per-project tool pinning (`uv tool` environments are global/isolated; per-project tools are only implied via `uv run ruff`), documented lock-enforcement modes for install/sync, independent hands-on corroboration that pins are honored.
